title: Radiative heat transfer in topological nodal-ring semimetals
summary: Can electronic band topology leave a fingerprint in thermal radiation? The resulting temperature-sensitive radiative response connects topological electronic states with nanoscale energy modulation and offers a platform for thermal switching, thermal rectification, and thermal stabilization.

title: Observation of gapped Dirac magnons in a Co bilayer grown on Ru(0001)
summary: Long celebrated in graphene, Dirac physics inspires the search for similar phenomena in magnonic systems. Here, the authors experimentally demonstrate that magnons in an epitaxial Co bilayer on Ru(0001) exhibit Dirac properties near the Brillouin zone corner. Remarkably, the substrate does not destroy the essential physics; despite breaking sublattice symmetry and opening a gap, local valley topology remains intact. Beyond opening possibilities for discovering Dirac magnons in other ultrathin 3 magnetic films, these findings hold promise for on-chip magnonic applications.
